reviews.text: Hardcore slash and bash. It starts to shine once you start getting ultra speed. Sometimes you get lost in all the colors but overall once you lock in even restarts are fluid. Brutal, fast and feels nice to splash when they line up behind the door.

Brutal, high octane, fist-clenching white knuckle action. Imagine Hotline Miami but Eldritch Horror with a Metal/Synth soundtrack. I couldn't stop playing it until I rolled credits, and the race to grab all the highest medals and earn a spot on the leaderboards is addictive and adds replayability. I got the game with a steam key, but would happily pay the price for the experience. Works well on Steamdeck and with a controller, too

This game broke the R key on my keyboard!!! Just kidding. But I did use it a lot (to respawn after each time I died). You'll be glad that respawning is instantaneous so you can just go and go and go. The soundtrack absolutely shreds. I found myself headbanging while playing and I bet I'm not the only one. If you like the demo you'll definitely wanna buy it! Reminding me of Dark Souls, there's a whole cosmology and lore to the story that went right over my head, but I might go back to get all the speed times and unlock the tomes where you can read that stuff. But all of that was totally optional so yeah--just kill everything and win the game is a great way to play too.

Played the demo and loved it, full game is even better. Getting into a combo line feels so good in this game, hard to master but in a good way. New weapons are sick, very unique playstyles when u combine them with the new amulets. Lots of replay ability and not to say its a short game, especially if you're trying to get collectables and leaderboard times.

The developers fixed a game breaking bug for me, took the time to write on my negative review i left and responded to my bug report that it wqs fixed. I bought the game again to give it a try, and it works great. Not only has the bug been fixed, I've been playing the game on the Game Native app on my S21 fe phone and it works flawless without any lag. I spent part of my lunch break playing it with my ROG android controller. I now have a new lunch time time waster. Thanks to the Devs for reaching out after fixing the bug.

Great take on the Hotline Miami formula. The game is a lot of fun, and has a banger soundtrack. However, it's also only about two hours long and ugly as sin. Nevertheless, I strongly recommend it to any Hotline Maimi fan.

Slaughter Void is my new favorite game. The soundtrack is very late 80s early 90s thrash and death metal inspired which is what I grew up listening to. The gameplay is both challenging and rewarding. Each time you finish a level a sense of accomplishment washes over you. Seriously, if you enjoy Hotline Miami and want to have a badass metal soundtrack this is the game for you!

Finished the demo and immediately had to get the full game, I've only beat the first 3 sections but it is great so far. Take Hotline Miami and replace 80s Miami Synthwave Fever Dream, with Sword and Planet Heavy Metal Barbaric Badassery, and you have Slaughter Void.

game is awesome! its like hotline miami and a heavy metal conan had a baby! 11/10 on the dopamine scale.

totally worth the asking price. though short, it delivers on the promised adrenaline rush and gives players a varied set of weapons and tools to figure out which combination slaughters demons best for you. the smartest decision made in this game is having your combo increase your move speed as it goes higher and higher. once you build that momentum you feel unstoppable, until you step in acid like I always did lol. and while you can still finish the level with the help of a shield, you will want to replay the level to get the maximum combo and the best time possible.
Great arcade and challenging game with a decent feel to it. Great for wasting a few minutes if you can't devote a bunch of time to game. Quick dopamine, or frustration... Git Good to feel good!

[h1]A Sledgehammer Full of Gore[/h1] [b][url=https://youtu.be/ACnniv-poc4] Check out the full breakdown on 2 Headed Hero![/url][/b] Fast, frantic speedrunning game about genociding hordes of unsavory demons with a big hammer, as well as other appropriate tools. Hotline Miami meets Gauntlet with death metal flavoring and 80s comic book vibes. Short but sweet! Full breakdown in our latest roundup: https://youtu.be/ACnniv-poc4

Very fast paced, adrenaline-filled action. Some decent weapon and relic variety. Each weapon also has a special attack. Controls feel very smooth and responsive. Addictive gameplay loop. Challenging without feeling punishing or unfair. Story and worldbuilding sits firmly in the "who cares" category for me but that's not what this game is about. I 100 percented it in 4 hrs including achievements. It has more replayability if you want to go beyond achievements and try to compete in the global scoreboards. I have no negatives to complain about but bear in the mind that especially if you're not aiming for achievements or if you're simply a more mechanically gifted player you might finish this far quicker than 4 hours. Still an easy recommendation for a short and sweet game to at the very least consider when it goes on sale.
